name: @arkimedehq/openclaw-recordare
description: Recordare for OpenClaw: long-term episodic memory kept by your own Recordare service (capture, recall before each turn, memory tools).
author: Andrea Genovese

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:openclaw --alias:@arkimedehq/recordare-client=../../packages/client/src/index.ts --metafile=dist/meta.json --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __recordareCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __recordareCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && node ../scripts/bundle-licenses.mjs dist/meta.json dist/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt && rm dist/meta.json
